<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/api/chat/conversations"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns a combined inbox of enabled `FAMILY` conversations and
`PRIVATE` direct conversations, newest `updatedAt` first. Family
conversations include all current family members; a private
conversation appears only while the caller is one of its two explicit
participants and the pair currently share a family. The list is not
paginated. This route requires server feature `directMessages`.
